timecoded_text_to_speech.text: I am Mike Egan. I'm a former Green Beret in the US Army and I'm running for Congress in the 6th Congressional District of Texas.

A lot of other candidates will say that they support the Second Amendment, but let me assure you that as an avid sports shooter who reloads his own ammunition as Grasch, I will fight for your Second Amendment right because I believe it is a fundamental right and I would want to take it away from me or you.

I don't waste my brass and I will waste any time in a work for you in Congress. Vote for me on Election Day on May 1st or during early in-person voting from April 16th to April 27th. I will let you down.
